source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第10.7–10.9段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第25題及指引註腳70

en.q: An ordering MSO processes a wire transfer without an account number after previously verifying the originator under the applicable requirements. Which statements are correct?
statements: A substitute unique reference number must still permit the transfer to be traced.
Previously compliant identity verification can make the required originator information deemed accurate.
The ordering MSO has no discretion to verify again even if this particular case warrants it.
Any customer identification number used must refer to a record held by the beneficiary institution.
notes: True: ¶10.7–10.9 A substitute reference must permit traceability.
True: FAQ Q25 Accuracy is deemed when identity was verified in accordance with the requirements.
False: FAQ Q25 Further verification is normally unnecessary but remains discretionary in individual cases.
False: ¶10.7–10.9 The relevant record is held by the ordering institution.

tc.q: 匯款機構處理沒有帳戶號碼的電傳轉帳，並已按適用規定核實匯款人。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 替代的獨特參考編號仍須使該筆電傳轉帳可被追蹤。
先前符合規定的身分核實，可使所需匯款人資料視作準確。
即使此個案有需要，匯款機構亦沒有酌情再核實資料的權力。
所用客戶識別號碼須指向收款機構所保存的紀錄。
notes: 正確：第10.7–10.9段，替代參考編號必須可追蹤電傳轉帳。
正確（常見問題第25題）：第10.7–10.9段，按條例及指引核實身分後，所需資料可視作準確。
錯誤（常見問題第25題）：第10.7–10.9段，通常不必再核實，但個別情況仍可酌情進一步核實。
錯誤：第10.7–10.9段，有關紀錄應由匯款機構持有，而非收款機構。

en.text: The unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution or beneficiary institution referred to in paragraphs [10.5] and [10.6] should permit traceability of the wire transfer.
The required originator information is deemed to be accurate if the identity of the originator has been verified in compliance with the AMLO and the AML/CFT Guideline.
No further verification of the originator information is normally required, although ordering institutions may exercise their discretion to do so in individual cases.

The customer identification number must refer to a record held by the originating institution which contains at least one of the following: the customer address, the identification document number, or the date and place of birth.

tc.text: 第[10.5]及[10.6]段所指由匯款機構或收款機構編配的獨特參考編號應可用作追蹤有關電傳轉帳。
如匯款人的身分已經根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢指引》的規定核實，則所需的匯款人資料便視為準確。
一般而言，無需再進一步核實匯款人資料，但匯款機構仍可運用酌情權就個別個案進行核實。
客戶識別號碼必須參照由發起機構持有的紀錄，該紀錄最少包含下列其中一項資料：客戶的地址、識別文件號碼或出生日期及地點。

en.q: An ordering MSO batches one originator’s overseas transfers and separately sends domestic transfers without full originator details. Which statements are correct?
statements: The overseas batch file should include the required recipient information as well as required accurate originator information.
For the incomplete domestic transfer, complete originator information must be available immediately on a law-enforcement request.
Regular audit or internal-control testing can help identify outgoing transfers missing required information.
Finding an information-control defect calls for timely rectification, alongside risk-based handling policies.
notes: True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 The batch file must contain both categories, fully traceable in the recipient country.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Domestic originator information should be available immediately to law enforcement.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Regular review or testing is an example of a reasonable detection measure.
True: ¶10.10, ¶10.12–10.13 Risk-based handling and timely rectification are both required.

tc.q: 匯款機構把同一匯款人的海外轉帳批量處理，另有本地轉帳未附完整匯款人資料。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 海外批量檔案除所需準確匯款人資料外，亦應包含所需收款人資料。
本地轉帳未附完整資料時，執法機構要求後應即時可取得完整匯款人資料。
定期審核或內部管控測試，可協助識別欠缺所需資料的匯出轉帳。
發現資料管控缺失時，應及時糾正，並備有風險為本處理政策。
notes: 正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，批量檔案應包括兩類資料，並可在收款人國家全面追蹤。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，執法機構要求時，應即時可提供本地轉帳匯款人資料。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，定期覆核或測試是識別欠缺資料的合理措施例子。
正確：第10.10, 第10.12–10.13段，所列要求包括風險為本處理及及時糾正缺失。

en.text: the batch file should contain required and accurate originator information, and required recipient information, that is fully traceable within the recipient country.
In addition, such information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon request.

taking reasonable measures (e.g. regular review or testing by internal control or audit function to assess system capabilities) to identify whether domestic or cross-border wire transfers lack required originator information or required recipient information

having risk-based policies and procedures for handling wire transfers lacking required originator information or required recipient information, and timely rectifying any control deficiencies identified.

tc.text: 群組檔案應載有所需及準確的匯款人資料及所需收款人資料，而該資料在收款人的國家可用作全面追查。
此外，該等資料亦需按執法機構要求立即提供。
採取合理措施（例如定期覆核或藉內部管控或審計職能進行測試，以評估系統功能），識辨本地或跨境電傳轉帳是否欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料
設有風險為本的政策及程序，以處理欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的電傳轉帳，並適時糾正所識別的管控不足之處。

en.q: A cross-border transfer loses accompanying information when an intermediary converts it to a domestic message because of technical limits. Which statements are correct?
statements: The intermediary may discard the received information once the domestic transfer has been completed.
The intermediary should use reasonable measures consistent with straight-through processing to detect missing information.
Every transfer with missing information must automatically be executed because the problem is technical.
The beneficiary institution may include post-event monitoring among measures to detect missing required information.
notes: False: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Technical limitations trigger retention of all received information for at least five years.
True: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Reasonable detection measures must be consistent with straight-through processing.
False: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Risk-based policies determine execution, rejection or suspension and follow-up.
True: ¶10.15–10.16, ¶10.19 Post-event monitoring is expressly an example for beneficiary institutions.

tc.q: 跨境轉帳因技術限制，在中介機構轉為本地訊息時未能保留隨附資料。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 本地轉帳完成後，中介機構便可丟棄收到的資料。
中介機構應採取與直接處理方式相符的合理措施，識別缺漏資料。
欠缺資料被歸類為技術問題，因此每筆此類轉帳均須自動執行。
收款機構可把事後監察列為識別缺少所需資料的措施。
notes: 錯誤：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，技術限制下應把收到的全部資料保存最少五年。
正確：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，識別欠缺資料的合理措施須與直接處理方式相符。
錯誤：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，應按風險為本政策決定執行、拒絕或暫停及跟進。
正確：第10.15–10.16, 第10.19段，指引明列收款機構可用事後監察作識別措施。

en.text: the intermediary institution should keep a record, for at least five years, of all the information received from the ordering institution or another intermediary institution.
taking reasonable measures, which are consistent with straight-through processing, to identify cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information

having risk-based policies and procedures for determining: (i) when to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator information or required recipient information; and (ii) the appropriate follow-up action.
taking reasonable measures (e.g. post-event monitoring) to identify domestic or cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information

tc.text: 中介機構應將從匯款機構或另一間中介機構接收的所有資料存檔，為期至少5年。
採取與直通式處理程序一致的合理措施，以識辨欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的跨境電傳轉帳
設有風險為本的政策及程序，以斷定：(i)何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的電傳轉帳；及(ii)適當的跟進行動。
採取合理措施（例如事後監察），以識辨欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的本地或跨境電傳轉帳

en.q: A beneficiary institution receives a HK$9,000 wire transfer with meaningless originator information; the recipient’s identity was previously verified. Which statements are correct?
statements: Prior verification means the amount alone does not require the recipient’s identity to be verified afresh.
The prior recipient verification makes meaningless originator information acceptable without risk-mitigation steps.
Risk-based handling procedures should determine execution, rejection or suspension and suitable follow-up.
Domestic transfers fall outside the duty to detect missing required information that applies to international transfers.
notes: True: ¶10.19–10.22 At or above the threshold, recipient verification is required if not previously verified.
False: ¶10.19–10.22 Meaningless accompanying information requires reasonable risk-mitigation measures.
True: ¶10.19–10.22 The beneficiary institution needs risk-based handling and follow-up policies.
False: ¶10.19–10.22 Beneficiary detection covers domestic and cross-border transfers alike.

tc.q: 收款機構收到9,000港元轉帳，匯款人資料無意義；收款人身分先前已核實。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 既已核實身分，毋須僅因轉帳款額而再次核實收款人身分。
收款人已核實，便使無意義的匯款人資料可在不減低風險下接受。
應按風險為本程序決定執行、拒絕或暫停，並作適當跟進。
本地轉帳不在適用於跨境轉帳的識別欠缺所需資料責任範圍內。
notes: 正確：第10.19–10.22段，達門檻時的核實要求適用於先前尚未核實的收款人。
錯誤：第10.19–10.22段，隨附資料無意義須採取合理減低風險措施，收款人核實不能代替。
正確：第10.19–10.22段，收款機構須備有風險為本處理及跟進政策。
錯誤：第10.19–10.22段，收款機構識別要求同時涵蓋本地及跨境轉帳。

en.text: For a wire transfer of amount equal to or above $8,000 (or an equivalent amount in any other currency), a beneficiary institution should verify the identity of the recipient, if the identity has not been previously verified.
If the beneficiary institution is aware that the accompanying information that purports to be the required originator information or required recipient information is incomplete or meaningless

having risk-based policies and procedures for determining: (i) when to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator information or required recipient information; and (ii) the appropriate follow-up action.
taking reasonable measures (e.g. post-event monitoring) to identify domestic or cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information

tc.text: 就款額相等於8,000元或以上（或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額）的電傳轉帳，如收款機構未曾核實收款人的身分，便應加以核實。
如收款機構察覺到附隨於電傳轉帳看來是所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料並不完整，或不具意義，它須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。
設有風險為本的政策及程序，以斷定：(i)何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的電傳轉帳；及(ii)適當的跟進行動。
採取合理措施（例如事後監察），以識辨欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的本地或跨境電傳轉帳

en.q: A trustee establishes a relationship for a family trust whose beneficiaries are defined as the settlor’s children. Which statements are correct?
statements: The trustee acting for the trust should also be regarded as a customer and have its identity verified.
Defining beneficiaries by class removes the need to obtain information about that class before payout.
Any protector and any other natural person with ultimate control belong within the relevant identification exercise.
A redacted trust deed suffices even where exceptional circumstances do not justify its use.
notes: True: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 The trustee entering the relationship on behalf of the trust is also a customer.
False: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 Sufficient information is needed to establish identity at payout or exercise of vested rights.
True: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 The trust identification scope includes protector and ultimate controllers.
False: ¶4.3.10, ¶4.3.12, ¶4.4.11–4.4.12 Use of a redacted copy is framed as an exceptional circumstance.

tc.q: 受託人為家族信託建立關係，受益人按財產授予人的子女類別界定。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 代表信託行事的受託人亦應視為客戶，並核實其身分。
按類別界定受益人，可免除在付款前取得該類別相關資料的需要。
任何保護人及其他有最終控制權的自然人，屬相關識別工作的範圍。
經編輯的信託契據仍然足夠，即使缺乏支持採用的特殊情況。
notes: 正確：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，代表信託建立關係的受託人亦屬客戶。
錯誤：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，須先取得足夠資料，以在付款或行使歸屬權益時確立身分。
正確：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，信託識別範圍包括保護人及最終控制的自然人。
錯誤：第4.3.10, 第4.3.12, 第4.4.11–4.4.12段，採用經編輯副本屬特殊情況安排，不是無條件規則。

en.text: regard the trustee22 as its customer if the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust, which is generally the case if the trust does not possess a separate legal personality. In such a case, the MSO should identify and verify the identity of the trustee
to satisfy the MSO that it will be able to establish the identity of the beneficiary at the time of payout or when the beneficiary intends to exercise vested rights

an MSO should identify the settlor, the trustee, the protector (if any), the enforcer (if any), the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control over the trust
Under exceptional circumstance, the MSO may choose to retain a redacted copy.

tc.text: 如受託人代表信託建立業務關係或執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者應把受託人22視作客戶，此情況一般會在信託不具備獨立法人身分時出現。在此情況下，金錢服務經營者應按照識別和核實屬自然人或法人（如適用）的客戶的規定，識別和核實受託人的身分。
讓該金錢服務經營者信納可以在付款時，或受益人擬行使歸屬於該受益人的權益時，確立受益人的身分
金錢服務經營者應識別該信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人（如有）、執行人（如有）、受益人或某類別受益人、及任何對該信託行使最終控制權的自然人
在特殊情況下，金錢服務經營者可選擇保存文書的刪節本。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q21
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第21題

en.q: A former non-Hong Kong PEP supplies the name of a sending bank and says retirement automatically ended all enhanced checks. Which statements are correct?
statements: Knowing the sending bank’s name establishes the activity that generated the particular funds.
A fixed period out of office does not by itself automatically end the former PEP’s enhanced measures.
Source of wealth is the origin of the particular remittance, rather than the person’s overall wealth.
Suitable overseas senior management may approve where the MSO’s organisational arrangements support this.
notes: False: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 Source of funds extends beyond the transfer location to the activity generating the funds.
True: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 Former PEP treatment requires risk assessment rather than an automatic prescribed period.
False: ¶4.9.12 and footnote 37, ¶4.9.24–4.9.25 The description given is source of funds, not source of wealth.
True: FAQ Q21 Senior management can include personnel in another jurisdiction where appropriate.

tc.q: 一名已卸任非香港政治人物提供匯出銀行名稱，並稱退休自動終止一切更嚴格審查。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 知道匯出銀行名稱，已能確立產生該筆特定資金的活動。
卸任達某固定年期，本身不會自動終止前政治人物的更嚴格措施。
財富來源是這筆特定匯款的來源，而不是當事人的整體財富來源。
如符合組織及風險管理安排，合適的海外高級管理人員可作審批。
notes: 錯誤：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，資金來源不僅是匯出地點，亦包括產生資金的活動。
正確：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，前政治人物的處理須按風險判斷，而非自動按固定年期終止。
錯誤：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，陳述描述的是資金來源，而非財富來源。
正確（常見問題第21題）：第4.9.12段及註37, 第4.9.24–4.9.25段，視乎組織架構及風險管理做法，高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區人員。

en.text: Source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from which the funds may have been transferred, but also the activity that generates the funds.
The handling of a former non-Hong Kong PEP should be based on an assessment of risk and not merely on prescribed time limits.
Source of wealth refers to the origin of an individual’s entire body of wealth (i.e. total assets).
Senior management may include personnel in another jurisdiction if this reflects the MSO’s organisational structure and risk management practices.

tc.text: 追查資金來源不應僅限於了解資金從何轉帳，亦要知悉衍生資金的活動。
前非香港政治人物的處理方法，應依據風險評估而定，不應僅訂明時限。
財富來源指個人全部財富（即總資產）的源頭。
倘人選能夠反映金錢服務經營者的組織結構及風險管理方法，高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區的人員。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.4.5; Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024, controls 6, 8–9 and 11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第4.4.5段；第三方付款通函，管控措施第6、8至9及11項

en.q: An individual receives frequent funding from an unrelated payer, but claims there is no need to identify anyone beyond the named customer. Which statements are correct?
statements: Indications that the customer acts for someone else should prompt enquiries about beneficial ownership.
The payer may itself be the true beneficial owner, a possibility the MSO should consider.
Difficulty verifying the relationship with the unrelated payer is a reason to exercise less scrutiny.
Documented enquiry findings and corroboration help demonstrate the third-party payment’s acceptance assessment.
notes: True: ¶4.4.5 The ordinary natural-person assumption yields to indications of acting for others.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: The third-party circular expressly highlights the true-owner possibility.
False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: Difficulty verifying the relationship calls for extra caution.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 6, 8–9 and 11: Findings and corroborative evidence should be documented.

tc.q: 個人客戶經常由無關連付款人提供資金，卻稱毋須識別客戶以外任何人。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 有跡象顯示客戶代表他人行事時，應就實益擁有權作適當查詢。
付款人本身可能才是真正實益擁有人，經營者應留意這種可能。
難以核實與無關連付款人的關係，是應減少審查的理由。
記錄查詢發現及佐證，有助顯示如何評估是否接納第三方付款。
notes: 正確：第4.4.5段，如有代他人行事跡象，不能只依賴自然人客戶通常就是實益擁有人的假設。
正確：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，第三方付款通函特別提醒付款人可能是真正實益擁有人。
錯誤：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，難以核實關係應提高警惕，並非減少審查。
正確：第三方付款通函第6、8至9及11項，評估及審批中的查詢發現及佐證應妥為記錄。

en.text: the MSO should make appropriate enquiries where there are indications that the customer is not acting on his own behalf.
MSOs should be alert to the possibility that the third-party payer is the true beneficial owner, and the risks to which that may give rise

MSOs should exercise extra caution when the relationship between the customer and the third party is hard to verify, the customer is unable to provide details of the identity of the third-party payer for verification before the payment is made, or a single third party is making or receiving payments for or from several seemingly unrelated customers.
The findings of enquiries made and corroborative evidence obtained during the evaluation and approval of a third party payment should be properly documented.

tc.text: 但如有跡象顯示該客戶並非代表其本身行事，則須進行適當查詢。
金錢服務經營者應就第三方付款人即真正實益擁有人的可能以及從而產生的風險保持警覺
若客戶與第三方之間的關係難以核實、客戶在進行支付前無法就第三方付款人的身分提供詳細資料作核實之用，或一個第三方向數名看似沒有關連的客戶付款或從數名看似沒有關連的客戶收款時，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。
應妥為記錄評估第三方支付期間取得的查詢結果、核對證據，以及接納該次支付的批准。

source.tc: 第三方付款通函，管控措施第2、6及8至9項

en.q: An MSO is asked to accept payments by one unregulated person for several unrelated customers, without a credible commercial explanation. Which statements are correct?
statements: Repeated payments by the same person establish low risk simply because the payer is familiar to staff.
The reasons and need for the payments, payer identity and customer relationship should be critically assessed.
The MSO can replace management approval with the customer’s written assurance that the payment is legitimate.
Potentially suspicious activity calls for enquiries and investigation; a report does not require proof of laundering.
notes: False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: A single payer for unrelated customers is a specific extra-caution situation.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Due diligence includes reasons, identity and relationship.
False: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Acceptance requires stringent management approval, not a customer assurance substitute.
True: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2024 controls 2, 6, 8–9: Suspicion, rather than confirmed laundering, is the reporting threshold.

tc.q: 經營者被要求接受同一未受規管人士為多個無關連客戶付款，卻沒有可信的商業解釋。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 職員熟悉反覆付款的同一人，即可把相關重複付款評為低風險。
應審慎評估付款理由及需要、付款人身分，以及其與客戶的關係。
經營者可用客戶聲稱付款合法的書面保證，取代管理層批准。
可能可疑的活動須查詢及調查，提交報告並不要求先證實洗錢。
notes: 錯誤：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，同一付款人為無關連客戶付款，是須額外警惕的特定情況。
正確：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，第三方付款盡職審查包括理由、身分及關係。
錯誤：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，接納須受嚴格管理層審批，客戶保證不能取代。
正確：第三方付款通函第2、6及8至9項，報告以懷疑為門檻，而非已證實洗錢。

en.text: MSOs should exercise extra caution when the relationship between the customer and the third party is hard to verify, the customer is unable to provide details of the identity of the third-party payer for verification before the payment is made, or a single third party is making or receiving payments for or from several seemingly unrelated customers.

(a) critically evaluating the reasons of and the need for third party payments; (b) taking reasonable measures on a risk-sensitive basis to (i) verify the identities of the third parties; and (ii) ascertain the relationship between the third parties and the customers;

MSOs which accept third party payments should put in place clear and detailed policies and procedures for scrutinising them and ensuring that the acceptance of third party payments is subject to stringent management approval.
Suspicious transaction reports should be made to the JFIU when there are grounds for suspicion of ML or TF.

tc.text: 若客戶與第三方之間的關係難以核實、客戶在進行支付前無法就第三方付款人的身分提供詳細資料作核實之用，或一個第三方向數名看似沒有關連的客戶付款或從數名看似沒有關連的客戶收款時，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。
(a) 嚴格評估使用第三方支付的原因及需要； (b) 因應風險程度採取合理措施，以(i)核實第三方的身分；以及(ii)確定第三方與客戶之間的關係；
接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者應設立清晰詳細的政策及程序予以審查，並確保須經過管理層嚴格審批方可接受第三方支付。
如有懷疑洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的理由，應向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》第7.1, 第7.5, 第7.19段

en.q: A customer abandons a HK$2,000 remittance when asked for details, but the MSO has already formed a laundering suspicion. Which statements are correct?
statements: Abandoning the payment does not remove the reporting obligation arising from the formed suspicion.
The HK$2,000 amount exempts the case from reporting because it is below the wire-transfer CDD threshold.
The report should include the information on which the suspicion is based, despite the incomplete transaction.
The MSO must wait for the customer to return before it is permitted to submit an STR.
notes: True: ¶7.1, ¶7.5, ¶7.19 Reporting can be required even where no transaction is conducted.
False: ¶7.1, ¶7.5, ¶7.19 Suspicion reporting applies irrespective of amount and covers attempts.
True: ¶7.1, ¶7.5, ¶7.19 The report must carry the matters underlying knowledge or suspicion.
False: ¶7.1, ¶7.5, ¶7.19 An STR can precede a transaction even if it never takes place.

tc.q: 客戶被要求提供詳情後放棄2,000港元匯款，但經營者已形成洗錢懷疑。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 放棄付款不會取消因已形成懷疑而產生的舉報責任。
2,000港元低於電傳轉帳盡職審查門檻，因此可豁免舉報。
即使交易未完成，報告亦應載有構成懷疑基礎的資料。
經營者必須等客戶再次到來，才獲准提交可疑交易報告。
notes: 正確：第7.1, 第7.5, 第7.19段，即使交易並無進行，仍可須提交可疑交易報告。
錯誤：第7.1, 第7.5, 第7.19段，懷疑舉報不受金額限制，亦涵蓋試圖交易。
正確：第7.1, 第7.5, 第7.19段，報告須連同知悉或懷疑所根據的事宜。
錯誤：第7.1, 第7.5, 第7.19段，報告可先於交易，即使交易最終不曾發生。

en.text: an MSO should file an STR even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO
The reporting obligations require a person to report suspicions of ML/TF, irrespective of the amount involved.
The STR should be made together with any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based.
an STR may be made either before a suspicious transaction or activity occurs (whether the intended transaction ultimately takes place or not), or after a transaction or activity has been completed

tc.text: 即使金錢服務經營者沒有進行交易，亦沒有交易透過金錢服務經營者進行，也應該提交可疑交易報告
舉報責任要求任何人舉報懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，而不論所涉金額
該項知悉或懷疑所根據的任何事宜應連同可疑交易報告一併提交
金錢服務經營者可在可疑交易或活動發生前提交可疑交易報告（而不論該擬作交易最終有否成事）

en.q: A cashier suspects a valued customer, but a sales manager without compliance duties proposes suppressing the internal report to protect revenue. Which statements are correct?
statements: The sales manager may filter the report because preserving a major relationship is a business necessity.
Consultation with a supervisor can be permitted, but the report must reach the MLRO without undue delay.
Reporting to the MLRO under the established procedure satisfies the cashier’s statutory reporting obligation.
The internal report may omit why the cashier is suspicious if the customer’s name is supplied.
notes: False: ¶7.12–7.16 Managers without reporting or compliance responsibility must not filter staff reports.
True: ¶7.12–7.16 Consultation does not displace prompt delivery to the MLRO.
True: ¶7.12–7.16 Reporting according to the MSO procedure satisfies the staff member’s obligation.
False: ¶7.12–7.16 Sufficient customer details and the information giving rise to suspicion are needed.

tc.q: 收銀員懷疑重要客戶，但沒有合規職責的營業經理建議壓下內部報告以保障收入。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 保留重要客戶是業務需要，因此營業經理可篩除這份報告。
可容許先與主管商討，但報告須不受不當延誤地送達洗錢報告主任。
收銀員按既定程序向洗錢報告主任舉報後，已履行個人的法定舉報責任。
內部報告已提供客戶姓名，便可省略收銀員懷疑的原因。
notes: 錯誤：第7.12–7.16段，無洗錢舉報或合規職責的管理人員不得篩除職員報告。
正確：第7.12–7.16段，商討安排不能取代及時把報告送交洗錢報告主任。
正確：第7.12–7.16段，職員按經營者程序向洗錢報告主任舉報即履行責任。
錯誤：第7.12–7.16段，報告須有客戶足夠詳情及引起懷疑的資料。

en.text: under no circumstances should reports raised by staff be filtered out by supervisors or managers who have no responsibility for the money laundering reporting/compliance function
all internal reports must reach the MLRO without undue delay
the statutory obligation of the staff has been fully satisfied
The internal report should include sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion.

tc.text: 在任何情況下，非負責洗錢報告╱合規職能的主管或經理均不得過濾職員所提交的報告
所有內部報告必須送達洗錢報告主任，不得出現無故延誤
該職員已完全履行了有關法定規定
內部報告應包括有關客戶的充分詳情，以及導致產生懷疑的全部資料

en.q: The MLRO sees one suspicious transfer and discovers connected accounts, while further information gathering could take several weeks. Which statements are correct?
statements: The MLRO should consider relevant CDD and monitoring information rather than judging only the isolated transfer.
Connected-account patterns are preferably reviewed on a relationship basis rather than transaction by transaction.
The MLRO should delay reporting formed suspicion until the search for every potentially connected account is complete.
The review process and its conclusions should both be documented, including the reasons for the eventual decision.
notes: True: ¶7.17–7.19 All relevant available information is part of the review.
True: ¶7.17–7.19 The Guideline prefers a relationship-based approach.
False: ¶7.17–7.19 Information searches must be balanced against timely reporting.
True: ¶7.17–7.19 Documenting conclusions alone is insufficient.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任發現一筆可疑轉帳及相關帳戶，但收集更多資料可能需數星期。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 洗錢報告主任應考慮相關盡職審查及監察資料，而非只看孤立轉帳。
相關帳戶交易模式宜按業務關係層面覆核，而非逐筆孤立處理。
洗錢報告主任應延遲舉報已形成的懷疑，直至完成搜尋每個可能相關帳戶。
洗錢報告主任的覆核過程及所得結論均應記錄，包括作出最終決定的理據。
notes: 正確：第7.17–7.19段，覆核應顧及一切可取得的相關資料。
正確：第7.17–7.19段，指引以業務關係為本的覆核方法為佳。
錯誤：第7.17–7.19段，搜尋資料須與及時提交報告的法定要求取得平衡。
正確：第7.17–7.19段，不能只記結論，亦應記錄覆核程序。

en.text: the MLRO must take reasonable steps to consider all relevant information, including CDD and ongoing monitoring information available within or to the MSO
preferably adopting a relationship-based approach rather than on a transaction-by-transaction basis
should strike an appropriate balance between the statutory requirement to make a timely STR to the JFIU and any delays that might arise
The review process should be documented, together with any conclusions drawn.

tc.text: 洗錢報告主任必須採取合理步驟以考慮所有相關資料，包括金錢服務經營者內部使用或提供予金錢服務經營者的有關報告所牽涉實體的盡職審查及持續監察資料
採用的方法應盡可能以關係為本，並非以個別交易為本
但亦應在及時向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的法定規定，以及因須搜尋更多關連戶口或關係的相關資料而引致延誤之間取得適當平衡
有關覆核過程，連同所得出的結論均應記錄在案

en.q: After reviewing all available information in good faith, an MLRO concludes that an internal report does not justify suspicion. Which statements are correct?
statements: The mere existence of an internal report compels an external STR regardless of the MLRO’s assessment.
The MLRO should keep records of deliberations and actions to demonstrate that the decision was reasonable.
The internal-report register should indicate that the matter did not result in a report to JFIU.
The absence of an external STR permits deletion of the identities of staff who handled the internal report.
notes: False: ¶7.17, ¶7.20, ¶7.29 Good-faith evaluation can result in a no-suspicion conclusion.
True: ¶7.17, ¶7.20, ¶7.29 A decision not to file still requires proper records.
True: ¶7.17, ¶7.20, ¶7.29 The record must show whether the internal report led to an STR.
False: ¶7.17, ¶7.20, ¶7.29 The staff who subsequently handled the internal report must be recorded.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任真誠考慮所有可取得資料後，認為內部報告不構成懷疑。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 內部報告必須對外舉報，即使洗錢報告主任已評估並確定沒有懷疑。
洗錢報告主任應保存考慮及行動紀錄，證明決定是合理作出。
內部報告登記冊應記明此事未導致向財富情報組提交報告。
既沒有對外報告，便可刪除處理內部報告職員的身分紀錄。
notes: 錯誤：第7.17, 第7.20, 第7.29段，真誠評估所有資料後，可以得出沒有懷疑的結論。
正確：第7.17, 第7.20, 第7.29段，決定不提交報告仍須保存適當紀錄。
正確：第7.17, 第7.20, 第7.29段，紀錄須載明內部報告有否導致對財富情報組舉報。
錯誤：第7.17, 第7.20, 第7.29段，須記錄其後處理內部報告的職員，並非只記對外舉報案件。

en.text: it is unlikely that there will be any criminal liability for failing to report if the MLRO concludes that there is no suspicion after taking into account all available information
It is however vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate he has acted in reasonable manner.
whether the internal report resulted in an STR to the JFIU
the staff members subsequently handling the report

tc.text: 而洗錢報告主任是在考慮過所有可獲取的資料後作出沒有可疑情況的結論，則不大可能會因沒有報告而負上刑事法律責任
最重要的是洗錢報告主任必須將他們的慎重考慮和採取的行動妥為備存紀錄，證明他們是以合理的方式行事
內部報告有否導致須向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
其後處理報告的人員

The initial report is recommended to state any intention to terminate the business relationship.

True: ¶7.21–7.23 The wording is to consider an initial telephone notification.
True: ¶7.21–7.23 The recommendation concerns the initial STR.
True: ¶7.21–7.23 Quality should reflect regulator and JFIU feedback and guidance.

tc.q: 正受調查的客戶要求即時取現及結束帳戶，經營者正在準備首次可疑交易報告。下列哪些陳述正確？

即使報告緊急，仍應考慮財富情報組及關長的反饋以確保質量。

正確：第7.21–7.23段，原文是應考慮先作電話通知。
正確：第7.21–7.23段，相關建議針對首次可疑交易報告。
正確：第7.21–7.23段，報告質量應顧及關長及財富情報組的反饋及指引。

tc.text: 如出現須作出緊急報告的情況（例如客戶已指示金錢服務經營者移動資金或其他財產、結束戶口、安排現金備取或對業務關係作出重大變動等），特別是當有關戶口是執法機構正在進行調查的一部分，則金錢服務經營者應在可疑交易報告中述明

en.q: An MSO reports a proposed transaction before acting and receives JFIU consent, then asks what protection the response provides. Which statements are correct?
statements: The pre-transaction defence relates to disclosed acts performed with the JFIU’s consent.
The consent certifies that all future activity in the account is free from money laundering risk.
The statutory defence removes all reputational risks connected with continuing the relationship.
If imminent action becomes necessary, the MSO should act appropriately and seek legal advice where necessary.
notes: True: ¶7.24–7.26 The defence applies to the disclosed acts subject to consent.
False: ¶7.24–7.26 Consent is not a clean bill of health for continuing operation.
False: ¶7.24–7.26 The defence does not absolve associated legal, regulatory or reputational risks.
True: ¶7.24–7.26 The guidance addresses imminent action with appropriate steps and legal advice.

tc.q: 經營者在執行擬議交易前舉報，並獲財富情報組同意，現評估同意帶來的保障。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 交易前舉報的免責辯護，關乎經財富情報組同意而執行的已披露作為。
財富情報組的同意證明帳戶未來的一切活動，均不存在任何洗錢風險。
法定免責辯護取消經營者繼續業務關係所涉及的一切聲譽風險。
如須採取即時行動，經營者應適當應對，並在有需要時尋求法律意見。
notes: 正確：第7.24–7.26段，免責辯護適用於取得同意後執行的已披露作為。
錯誤：第7.24–7.26段，同意不是繼續經營帳戶的無風險證明。
錯誤：第7.24–7.26段，免責辯護不會解除相關法律、監管或聲譽風險。
正確：第7.24–7.26段，如須即時行動，指引要求採取適當行動及在必要時尋求法律意見。

en.text: the report is made before the MSO undertakes the disclosed acts and the acts (transaction(s)) are undertaken with the consent of the JFIU
should not be construed as a “clean bill of health” for the continued operation of the account
does not absolve an MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation
Otherwise, the MSO should take appropriate action and seek legal advice where necessary.

tc.text: 該報告是在金錢服務經營者作出所披露作為之前作出，而該作為（交易）是得到財富情報組的同意的
財富情報組就交易前的報告作出「同意」的回應，不應被解釋為該戶口持續運作的「健康證明」

否則金錢服務經營者便應採取適當行動，並按需要徵詢法律意見

en.q: An MSO reports on its own initiative after a transaction and then proposes continuing the customer relationship without further assessment. Which statements are correct?
statements: A post-transaction report can qualify for the defence if its timing and initiative meet the applicable conditions.
Filing the STR by itself makes any further review of risks in the continuing customer relationship unnecessary.
A relationship review should take place upon filing, regardless of any later feedback from JFIU.
Where escalation is necessary, JFIU replaces the MSO’s senior management in deciding how to handle the relationship.
notes: True: ¶7.25, ¶7.27 Post-act reporting must be on the MSO’s own initiative and as soon as reasonable.
False: ¶7.25, ¶7.27 Continuing without further risk consideration and controls is unacceptable.
True: ¶7.25, ¶7.27 Review upon filing is independent of subsequent feedback.
False: ¶7.25, ¶7.27 The escalation is to the MSO’s senior management.

tc.q: 經營者在交易後主動舉報，其後提議不作進一步評估便繼續客戶關係。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 交易後舉報須符合適用的時限及主動舉報條件，才可取得免責辯護。
提交可疑交易報告本身，就使進一步覆核關係風險變得不必要。
提交報告時應覆核業務關係，不論財富情報組其後有何反饋。
有需要上報時，由財富情報組取代經營者高級管理層決定如何處理關係。
notes: 正確：第7.25, 第7.27段，事後報告須出於經營者主動，並在合理範圍內盡快作出。
錯誤：第7.25, 第7.27段，不再考慮風險及管控便繼續關係並不可接受。
正確：第7.25, 第7.27段，提交後覆核不以其後反饋為條件。
錯誤：第7.25, 第7.27段，上報對象是經營者本身高級管理層。

en.text: the report is made on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as it is reasonable for the MSO to do so
continuing to operate the relationship without any further consideration of the risks and the imposition of appropriate controls to mitigate the risks identified is not acceptable

the issue should be escalated to the MSO's senior management to determine how to handle the relationship concerned

繼續運作該業務關係，而不再進一步考慮有關風險及施加適當的管控措施以減低所識辨的風險，是不可接受的做法

有關問題應上報至金錢服務經營者的高級管理層

en.q: A staff member reported suspicious cash transactions last month; the same customer now requests a different suspicious remittance. Which statements are correct?
statements: The earlier report does not discharge the need to report the newly suspicious remittance to the MLRO.
The MLRO should consider whether a further report to JFIU is appropriate on the new information.
The reporting procedure may insert several commercial approvals between staff and the MLRO for valuable customers.
The MLRO’s acknowledgement of the new internal report should remind the staff member about tipping off.
notes: True: ¶7.12–7.16, ¶7.28 Further suspicious events must still be reported, whether similar or different.
True: ¶7.12–7.16, ¶7.28 The MLRO should make further reports where appropriate.
False: ¶7.12–7.16, ¶7.28 Reporting lines should be as short as possible with minimal intervening people.
True: ¶7.12–7.16, ¶7.28 Acknowledgement and tipping-off reminder are MLRO responsibilities.

tc.q: 職員上月曾舉報可疑現金交易；同一客戶現要求另一類可疑匯款。下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 較早報告不會免除把新可疑匯款報告予洗錢報告主任的需要。
洗錢報告主任應按新資料考慮是否適宜再向財富情報組報告。
重要客戶的舉報程序可在職員及洗錢報告主任之間加入多重商業批准。

notes: 正確：第7.12–7.16, 第7.28段，無論性質相同或不同，進一步可疑事件仍須舉報。

en.q: An MSO builds one electronic register for internal disclosures and reports submitted to JFIU. Which statements are correct?

True: ¶7.29–7.30 The external record includes the report date and maker.
True: ¶7.29–7.30 Assessment results and paper-location information form part of the internal record.
True: ¶7.29–7.30 All internal reports must be recorded, with whether an STR resulted.

tc.q: 經營者建立一個電子登記冊，同時記錄內部披露及已交財富情報組的報告。下列哪些陳述正確？

en.q: An MSO receives a production order about a customer and expects difficulty meeting the deadline. Which statements are correct?

False: ¶7.31–7.32, ¶7.35 The response must include all material within the scope of the order.

True: ¶7.31–7.32, ¶7.35 Receipt of court documents or intelligence requests should trigger timely risk consideration.

tc.q: 經營者收到關於客戶的提交物料令，預期難以在限期內遵從。下列哪些陳述正確？

經營者應及時評估關係風險及有否需要覆核客戶。

en.q: A restraint order identifies particular funds in a customer relationship during an investigation, before any conviction. Which statements are correct?

tc.q: 調查期間且尚未定罪，限制令指定客戶關係內某些款項。下列哪些陳述正確？

en.q: A relationship ends on 30 June 2025; a transaction under it was completed on 1 March 2024. No longer-retention notice is initially in place. Which statements are correct?

The March 2024 transaction records can be destroyed when the relationship ends in June 2025.
The minimum clocks for the CDD file and the transaction record start from different events in this case.

True: ¶8.4, ¶8.6, ¶8.8 A written notice may require a longer specified period.
